text:
elaine: Spike idea: a 'mini-chooser' for contingency actions embedded in the rollout header. One-click apply for common cases, but with guards (rate-limits, audit, revert). Thoughts? :zap:
devon: Nice. I like the header placement. We need to show which route/model the action will affect and the active rollout id.
sara: Must display live matching signals (5xx%, p95 latency, quota hits). Operators should see "why this is suggested" not just the control.
kat: Suggestion: show suggested mode + a confidence bar from our detection rules (low/med/high). If confidence < medium, grey out "auto-apply" and force manual confirmation.
mike: Add a tiny inline "impact" line: cost delta, invocations delta, latency delta. Use single-digit percentages where possible.
elaine: Controls I'm proposing: Suggested mode chip (eg: soft-throttle), Apply button, Suppress-notify toggle (don't ping oncall), Duration presets, Quick-justification inline. Also a small 'undo' affordance for 2 minutes.
sara: Undo is critical. But also require a justification if the mode is escalated (soft->hard) or if suppress-notify is checked. Keeps people accountable.
kat: On telemetry: each apply event should include a deterministic breadcrumb id (format: contingency:<yyyymmdd>T<hhmmss>:<rollout-id>) and a snapshot token for matched signals (eg ts-20260322-09-17). That lets us feed the decision-sim.
mike: Backend also needs to compute conservative estimates for each mode. For example: soft-throttle -> cost -8%, p99 +2ms; quarantine -> cost +25%, invocations +30%. Show these inline.
james: small infra point (cc @ops-bot): avoid generating ephemeral random uuids for breadcrumb. Use the deterministic format so replay and auditability match exactly.
ops-bot: Preview UI available: https://console-preview.internal/mini-contingency?pr=1422 (simulated traffic, try the suggested apply flow).
elaine: Also proposing a "rate-limit guard": prevent more than 2 applies per rollout per 10m, and max 3 reverts per 10m. Display the guard state in tooltip.
sara: And log the revert reason as well. Reverts should include actor and a 120-char freeform note.
kat: UI detail: when you hover the cost delta show how it was computed (sample size, baseline period). Also let an operator expand matched signals and see raw counts.
mike: For the decision-sim replay we must include: breadcrumb id, rollout-id, mode, severity, duration, matched snapshot token. Example payload:```{
  "event":"contingency_apply",
  "actor":"elaine",
  "rollout":"rollout-42",
  "mode":"quarantine",
  "severity":"high",
  "duration":"2m",
  "breadcrumb":"contingency:20260322T091700:rollout-42",
  "snapshot":"ts-20260322-091700-07"
}```
elaine: Good. We'll also add an opt-in checkbox to capture a sample of failed prompts (attach repro set) for the model team if matched signals include prompt-safety or hallucination tags.
sara: Process question: auto-suggest vs auto-apply. I think auto-suggest only for low-severity, allow auto-apply when confidence high and a 10s confirmation countdown, with audit note. No silent auto-runs.
kat: Agree. Keep automatic actions rare. We can iterate later.
elaine: I'll prepare a short RFC with mocks (header chip + expanded flyout), the telemetry contract above, guard policy, and the backend breadcrumb format. Will include the preview link.
mike: Thanks. Add a section on how the console will display "actions taken by other operators" to avoid collisions (eg show pending apply by X).
elaine: Good call. I'll include concurrency hints and a "locked by" state in the mock. Thanks all :thumbsup:
